name: Airgun calculators (energy, ballistics, PCP fill)
about: Like ChairGun / MERO / PCPFill, offline: muzzle energy (J / ft·lb) and the velocity for an energy limit, a trajectory table (path, holdover in cm / mrad / MOA, velocity, energy, wind drift, best zero for a kill zone) from the pellet's G1 BC, and how many PCP fills a scuba or carbon tank gives.
description: Airgun numbers for target shooting / pest control: muzzle energy and energy limits, trajectory / holdover / zero / kill zone / wind drift (G1 BC), PCP fills from a scuba or carbon tank and shots per tank. Use it whenever an answer needs a number — don't guess.
instructions:
Pick ONE calculator and fill its inputs from the request. Write every value WITH its unit as text ("8.44 gr", "0.547 g", "900 fps", "280 m/s", "30 m", "45 mm", "232 bar", "180 cc"). Leave out what the user didn't say. Calculators and their inputs:
- energy: pellet_weight, velocity, limit ("16.3 J" / "12 ft-lb")
- trajectory: velocity, pellet_weight, bc (G1, e.g. 0.021), scope_height, zero, max_range, step, wind, temperature, kill_zone
- pcp_fill: tank_volume ("12 l"), tank_pressure, reservoir ("180 cc"), fill_pressure, refill_pressure, shots_per_fill
Example: {"calc": "trajectory", "inputs": {"velocity": "880 fps", "pellet_weight": "15.89 gr", "bc": "0.031", "zero": "30 m"}}. Answer with the JSON only.
